description: This file defines the LeaveTypeDao class, which manages database operations for LeaveType entities within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching leave types, as well as querying for leave types associated with employees.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for LeaveType entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and searches related to leave types.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of non-deleted leave types, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Fetches a LeaveType entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveTypeIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of leave types that exist and are not marked as deleted, given a list of IDs.

methods.name: saveLeaveType
methods.description: Persists a LeaveType entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLeaveType
methods.description: Marks a list of leave types as deleted based on their IDs.

methods.name: getDeletedLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of leave types that are marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeByName
methods.description: Finds a leave type by its name, excluding deleted ones.

methods.name: undeleteLeaveType
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted leave type by setting its deleted flag to false.

methods.name: searchLeaveType
methods.description: Searches for leave types matching specified filter parameters, returning a list.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypePaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator for leave type search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave types matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: hasEmployeeAllocatedLeavesForLeaveType
methods.description: Checks if an employee has any allocated leave requests for the specified leave type.
